escooter_action_clean.prompt_en: Natural location sound only: quiet electric scooter motor whirr, tire rolling sound, realistic wind, suspension movement, and surface-specific sounds such as light gravel impacts or subtle braking squeak when physically appropriate. No music. No speech. No voiceover. No narration. No combustion-engine or motorcycle sound. No cinematic trailer bass.

escooter_asphalt_clean.prompt_en: Natural asphalt riding sound only: subtle electric motor whirr, rubber tire roll, wind and light suspension movement. No music, no speech, no narration, no motorcycle or combustion-engine sound.

escooter_gravel_clean.prompt_en: Natural gravel riding sound only: quiet electric motor whirr, tire crunch on gravel, small stones scattering, wind and suspension movement. No music, no speech, no narration, no motorcycle or combustion-engine sound.
